arcs.title: The Porch Railing Situation
arcs.summary: Day 3: Don's portrait has produced a detailed construction diagram confirming the northeast corner post is seated on 'a good flat piece of oak I had' rather than the specified bracket. Don stands by this. Steve has studied the diagram at length. Adam has received a copy and is still expected Saturday. Christine has updated the household ledger. The railing has not creaked today. Day 4 (resolution) should bring Adam's Saturday visit, the joint inspection by Steve and Adam, a verdict on the oak and the bracket, and a resolution that is satisfying, funny, and — in the tradition of all great home construction — slightly vindicates Don while also explaining why the railing creaked.
